case_scope: United States K-12 school finance, property tax, facilities, and childhood place closure

place_public_finance_gate.note: School finance cannot pass by current spending averages alone; Census FY2024 finance data shows large state/local/property-tax dependence while research sources keep the equity and facility-capital question open.

school_finance_equalization.note: Equalization must be measured after cost adjustment, local fiscal effort, federal-relief fadeout, special education, and subgroup exposure.

property_tax_base_fragmentation.note: Local revenue and property-tax dependence remain part of the proof burden; state totals do not prove child-level equal service wealth. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD regional inequality evidence is now bound to place/property-tax fragmentation rather than unused context.

school_facility_capital_gap.note: Capital outlay and facility-condition evidence must be paired with operating funds because local capital gaps can persist after formula equalization.

public_service_floor_place_equality.note: Income-progressive funding improvements do not automatically remove race, segregation, facility, and local cost gaps.

proof_debt: post-relief fiscal cliff and federal share loss
special education and transportation cost adequacy

gate_15_place_public_finance.why: Gate 15 remains watch: school finance is too property- and place-mediated to count as durable service wealth without district-level cost, subgroup, and facility proof.

evidence_debt_register.question: district-level cost-adjusted operating funds
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Use FY2024 Census school-finance tables plus cost-of-education weights to compare usable operating funds across districts, not state averages.

evidence_debt_register.question: facilities condition and capital backlog
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Pair capital outlay and debt data with facility-condition evidence to test whether property-wealth districts buy childhood service wealth unavailable elsewhere.

evidence_debt_register.question: tax effort by property wealth
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Compare tax effort, assessed value, state aid, and local revenue share so low-wealth high-effort districts are not averaged away.

evidence_debt_register.question: racial/ethnic and disability subgroup exposure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Crosswalk finance gaps with racial segregation, disability services, English-learner needs, and poverty concentration rather than relying on equalization by income only.

evidence_debt_register.question: post-relief fiscal cliff and federal share loss
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Monitor whether temporary federal relief and local reserve use mask a near-term service-floor drop.

evidence_debt_register.question: special education and transportation cost adequacy
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Test whether transportation, special education, and student-support costs are fully funded at the district where the child faces the threshold moment.

validation_notes: rev0335 removed stale place_public_finance_gate_seed calibration label; active scoring now requires source-backed service-floor, fiscal-capacity, and threshold-moment evidence.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S244 to `property_tax_base_fragmentation` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
